placements.why: The position pairs a reproduced prod failure (a ## heading with no id field) with the requirement that the pipeline must not crash and must produce a valid slug. Future envelopes on id derivation, the slugify fallback or missing-field robustness would keep feeding this subject. The graph is empty, so nothing existing holds it. No lineage applies and no hub is available, so it stands alone.
placements.title: A memory with no id still gets a slug and commits
placements.frame: When a memory arrives lacking a field the pipeline expects, what does the pipeline do to still produce a valid result, and does it avoid crashing?

unconnected.why: No existing strata, and this single document gives no cross-graph grouping that a stratum would add beyond the leaf itself.
